question: Should this repository accept the single-operator, cross-repository GitHub App and Cloudflare mutation boundary as the approved bootstrap authority for crawl-remote Access credentials?
rationale: Implementation consistency does not establish the acceptable production operator, GitHub App installation scope, Cloudflare ownership, or recovery authority; those are repository-governance decisions that CI cannot resolve.

options.title: Require second-owner approval
options.body: Have another authorized owner verify the actor binding, GitHub App repository permissions, Cloudflare resource matching, and redacted recovery proof before merging while keeping consumers dormant.

options.title: Accept the proposed boundary
options.body: Merge based on the fail-closed checks and focused tests, making the named operator and current app scope the approved production authority.

options.title: Pause the bootstrap
options.body: Keep the draft open until the operator model and future atomic consumer cutover are sponsored together.

recommendation.title: Require second-owner approval
recommendation.body: Have another authorized owner verify the actor binding, GitHub App repository permissions, Cloudflare resource matching, and redacted recovery proof before merging while keeping consumers dormant.

likelyOwner.reason: The workflow names this account as the sole operator and the branch history shows direct ownership of its security and compatibility refinements.
